task: Zotero is installed and a pre-seeded library is at /home/user/Zotero/zotero.sqlite. A PDF file is provided at /home/user/Documents/attention_paper.pdf. Launch Zotero and wait for the library to load. Locate the existing item titled 'Attention Is All You Need'. Attach the PDF /home/user/Documents/attention_paper.pdf to that item as a child attachment. After attaching, the item must have at least one PDF attachment child. Leave Zotero running.
task_grounding: Zotero is installed and a pre-seeded library is at /home/user/Zotero/zotero.sqlite. A PDF file is provided at /home/user/Documents/attention_paper.pdf. Launch Zotero and wait for the library to load. Locate the existing item titled 'Attention Is All You Need'. Attach the PDF /home/user/Documents/attention_paper.pdf to that item as a child attachment (right-click the item > Add Attachment > 'Attach Stored Copy of File...' or drag the PDF onto the item). After attaching, the item must have at least one PDF attachment child. Leave Zotero running.

cli_feasibility.translation: Python script using SQLite + file operations: 1) Copy PDF to Zotero storage directory with unique key, 2) Insert attachment item record in items table, 3) Link attachment to parent item via parentItemID, 4) Update attachment metadata
cli_feasibility.reason: Zotero attachments are stored as items in the database with parentItemID pointing to the parent item. The PDF files go in ~/Zotero/storage/<key>/. A Python script can create the attachment record, copy the file to storage, and establish the parent-child relationship.
